sn12.1:1.1: For an overview of this topic, see my Introduction to the Saṁyutta Nikāya.
sn12.1:1.3: In a shift from the previous book, there is no interaction or dialogue; the teaching is a direct address by the Buddha.
sn12.1:2.14: There is no corresponding “dependent cessation”. The ending of dependent origination is Nibbana, extinguishment.
